description: Inference models used by the Strata vision engine. All run locally on CPU through ONNX Runtime; nothing is sent off-site. Verify SHA-256 before use. Licences are those of the upstream projects.

models.name: YOLOX-S (COCO, 80 classes)
models.licence: Apache-2.0 (Megvii YOLOX; ONNX export from OpenCV Model Zoo)
models.purpose: People, vehicles, aircraft, boats and birds in camera frames and uploaded media

models.name: YuNet face detector (2023mar)
models.purpose: Face boxes and five landmarks for alignment

models.name: SFace face recognition (128-d embedding)
models.purpose: Face embeddings for 1:1 verification and 1:N search against enrolled galleries

models.name: Real-ESRGAN General x4v3
models.purpose: Generative 4x upscaling. Output is AI-INFERRED: detail may be synthesised and is never used for identification
